error.noModule: The ryzen_smu kernel module isn't loaded, so there's nothing to read.
error.noModuleHint: Load it with: sudo modprobe ryzen_smu
error.unsupported: This CPU's power table (version %1) isn't supported yet.
error.unsupportedHint: Showing nothing rather than guessing at the layout.
error.short: The power table was shorter than expected.
row.stapm.name: Sustained power
row.stapm.help: Your long-run budget: power averaged over a few minutes can't go above this. This is the figure people call TDP.
row.slow.name: Medium-term power
row.slow.help: Power averaged over a few seconds. This is the limit that bites just after a burst.
row.fast.name: Burst power
row.fast.help: The ceiling for short spikes. The live figure is roughly what the chip is drawing right now.
row.tdcVdd.name: Core current, sustained
row.tdcVdd.help: Steady current the CPU cores may draw from their voltage regulator.
row.edcVdd.name: Core current, peak
row.edcVdd.help: Short spikes for the cores. The figure is a recent peak, so readings near the limit are normal.
row.tdcSoc.name: Graphics & I/O current, sustained
row.tdcSoc.help: Steady current for the graphics, memory controller and I/O.
row.edcSoc.name: Graphics & I/O current, peak
row.edcSoc.help: Short spikes for the graphics, memory controller and I/O.
row.thmCore.name: CPU temperature
row.thmCore.help: The chip throttles when its die reaches this temperature.
row.sttApu.name: Chassis temperature
row.sttApu.help: An estimate of how hot the case surface near the CPU is. The laptop throttles to keep it comfortable to touch.
row.sttDgpu.name: Graphics card chassis temperature
row.sttDgpu.help: The same estimate for a discrete graphics card.
settings.title: %1 settings
settings.showLabelHelp: Show live power and the sustained limit next to the tray icon. Off shows just the icon.
settings.showBarsHelp: Show a gauge under each reading for how close it is to its limit.
averagePower: Average %1 W over the last minute
settings.graphsFor: Show graphs of the last 60s for
settings.showLimitsHelp: Draw each reading's limit as a faint line on one shared scale. Off scales each line to its own limit.
tableUnverified: %1 table %2 · untested layout, please report any wrong readings
